typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		MANUALLY_ADDED as string,
		SYS_ID as string,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_NAME as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON as timestamp,
		NAME as string,
		CMDB_CI_SERVICE_NAME as string,
		SYS_MOD_COUNT as integer,
		CMDB_CI_SERVICE_GUID as string,
		SYS_CREATED_ON as timestamp,
		SERVICE_CLASSIFICATION_NAME as string,
		TASK_NUMBER as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY as string,
		ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SYS_CREATED_BY as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as date,
		TASK_GUID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		MANUALLY_ADDED as string,
		SYS_ID as string,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_NAME as string,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NAME as string,
		CMDB_CI_SERVICE_NAME as string,
		SYS_MOD_COUNT as integer,
		CMDB_CI_SERVICE_GUID as string,
		SYS_CREATED_ON as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SERVICE_CLASSIFICATION_NAME as string,
		TASK_NUMBER as string,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY as string,
		ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION as string,
		SYS_CREATED_BY as string,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TASK_GUID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MANUALLY_ADDED,
		SYS_ID,
		MANAGED_BY_GROUP_NAME,
		OPERATIONAL_STATUS_DESCRIPTION,
		SYS_UPDATED_ON,
		NAME,
		CMDB_CI_SERVICE_NAME,
		SYS_MOD_COUNT,
		CMDB_CI_SERVICE_GUID,
		SYS_CREATED_ON,
		SERVICE_CLASSIFICATION_NAME,
		TASK_NUMBER,
		SYS_UPDATED_BY,
		ENVIRONMENT_DESCRIPTION,
		SYS_CREATED_BY,
		TODSH_BUSINESS_EFFECTIVE_DATE,
		TASK_GUID),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
